corrections: Canvas2D now uses actual circular arcs rather than quadratic corner approximations.
Fill geometry respects the stroke centerline to avoid inflated contours and an oversized white center.
Group item minimum width, row/column/header spacing and example output extent match the native SDK metrics.
boundary: Live release inspection is separate from own forced-VSM RenderTargetBitmap matrices. Screenshots document observed shape and sample structure, not a present-time or pixel-equivalence acceptance.
